slides.headline: 10x leverage: how far can price move before you're out? [About 10%]

slides.photo_cap: Leverage makes small moves big, both ways
slides.title: So, how does leverage work?
paras: You put in <g>$100</g> of margin. At 10x you control a <g>$1,000</g> position. A 1% move is now a 10% move on your money.

slides.photo_cap: Higher leverage, smaller room to breathe
slides.title: Room before liquidation
paras: Rule of thumb: <g>100 ÷ leverage</g> = the % move against you that wipes out your margin. Fees and maintenance margin make it a bit less.

slides.title: How to stay in the trade
paras: Futures trading is high risk. Not financial advice.

rows: You choose the exit, not the liquidation
One bad trade won't hurt much
